001.name: Avery Obtainia

additional.text: On Summon Attach one Skill or Artifact from hand to self. Self and chosen ally gain +3 ATK and +4 HP until the end of turn.
Rest self to create 2 [Light] mana.
When self is resting, can still block 1 incoming attack, reducing it by -2. Have +1 DP while resting. For each ally that blocks an attack while self is resting, spend 1 [Light] mana to draw a card.

001.subtype: Angelor / Water Spirit / Mystical Legends / Tempest Aquia

002.name: Kiara Katzol

additional.text: Summon Requirement Place 1 of your Characters with 8 or more Power in your discard pile.
On Summon Restore 2 HP. Then choose 1 allied Character. It gains +3 Light Damage until the end of the turn.
Divine Catalyst: If Avery Obtainia has 10 or more Power, reduce all damage dealt to him by 1.
“Even the smallest light can become a beacon of hope.”
